enunciado: Which goal is achieved by the implementation of private IPv4 addressing on a network?

provides an added level of protection against Internet exposure

Option A (“allows servers and workstations to communicate across public network boundaries”) fails because private addresses do not by themselves enable free communication across public boundaries. Option B (“provides a reduction in size of the forwarding table on network routers”) is also incorrect: private addressing does not shrink the global Internet routing table for other enterprises, nor make private-to-private Internet paths routable without tunnels/NAT.
